scientific_limitations: The full ordinary Ewens fixed-point/adjacent-descent mixed covariance matrix and aggregate noncyclic covariance already appear in a November 8 locality theorem; the uniform circular cancellation is also known. The surviving contribution is the explicit positive-parameter circular boundary correction and its all-size covariance sign transition. No aggregate independence is claimed.
title: Cyclic fixed-point–descent covariance reverses sign at the unbiased Ewens law
